name: Melee
summary: Defeat a target with a melee attack.
exactTrigger: Use a melee attack for the killing blow.
notes: Verified from the managed kill-score calculator.

name: Explosion
summary: Defeat a target with an explosion.
exactTrigger: Use explosion damage for the killing blow.
notes: Verified from the managed kill-score calculator.

summary: Score a kill after a completed spin.
exactTrigger: Complete at least 320 degrees of rotation without pausing the turn for more than 0.5 seconds, then score the kill within 1 second.
notes: Verified from the managed kill-score calculator.

name: No Scope
summary: Score a ranged kill without aiming.
exactTrigger: Do not aim for at least 0.25 seconds before the killing shot.
notes: Verified from the managed kill-score calculator.

name: Quick Scope
summary: Score a ranged kill shortly after aiming.
exactTrigger: Score the kill within 0.5 seconds after you start aiming.
notes: Verified from the managed kill-score calculator.

name: Longshot
summary: Score a distant ranged kill.
exactTrigger: Score the kill from at least 25 distance units away.
notes: Verified from the managed kill-score calculator.

name: Headshot
summary: Score a ranged kill with a hit above the creature's head position.
exactTrigger: Land the killing shot above the creature's head-position line.
notes: Verified from the managed kill-score calculator.

name: Dogfight
summary: Defeat a flying target while airborne.
exactTrigger: Both you and the target must be airborne when the kill lands.
notes: Verified from the managed kill-score calculator.

name: Aerial
summary: Defeat a target while airborne.
exactTrigger: You must be airborne while the target stays on the ground.
notes: Verified from the managed kill-score calculator.

name: Fly Fishing
summary: Defeat a flying target from the ground.
exactTrigger: Kill an airborne target while you remain on the ground.
notes: Verified from the managed kill-score calculator.

name: Noob Kill
summary: Earn this when no earlier bonus has been added for the kill.
exactTrigger: Finish the target without earning another Killscore bonus on that kill.
notes: Verified from the managed kill-score calculator.

name: One Shot One Kill
summary: Defeat a full-health creature with one damaging hit.
exactTrigger: Take a full-health creature to zero with one damaging hit.
notes: Verified from the managed kill-score calculator.

name: Multikill
summary: Chain kills within the multikill time window.
exactTrigger: Chain at least two kills with no more than 3 seconds between them; the multiplier reaches its cap at 11 kills.
notes: Verified from the managed kill-score calculator.

name: Finally
summary: Score a kill after many shots without one.
exactTrigger: Score a kill after firing more than five shots without one.
notes: Verified from the managed kill-score calculator.

name: Endangered
summary: Defeat an endangered target.
exactTrigger: Defeat a creature marked as endangered.
notes: Verified from the managed kill-score calculator.

name: Killsteal
summary: Finish a target without having landed a local hit while it was above 30% health.
exactTrigger: Land the finishing blow at 30% health or lower without having hit the creature earlier in the fight.
notes: Verified from the managed kill-score calculator.

name: Point Blank
summary: Score a very close ranged kill.
exactTrigger: Score a ranged kill from less than 2 distance units away.
notes: Verified from the managed kill-score calculator.

name: Overkill
summary: Deal far more damage than needed to a non-boss target.
exactTrigger: Finish a non-boss target with enough excess damage to push its remaining health below -70.
notes: Verified from the managed kill-score calculator.

name: Last Bullet
summary: Score a kill after the shot empties the held weapon.
exactTrigger: Score the kill with the shot that empties your held weapon.
notes: Verified from the managed kill-score calculator.

name: Impressive
summary: Combine at least five other bonuses.
exactTrigger: Earn at least five other Killscore bonuses on the same kill.
notes: Verified from the managed kill-score calculator.
